commands: PLUGINS='workflow-aggregator credentials credentials-binding git git-client docker-workflow docker-plugin kubernetes aws-credentials amazon-ecr ssh-agent job-dsl'
if [ ! -f plugin-manager.jar ]; then curl -fsSL -o plugin-manager.jar https://repo.jenkins-ci.org/releases/io/jenkins/tools/plugin-manager/2.13.3/plugin-manager-2.13.3.jar || true; fi
if [ -f plugin-manager.jar ]; then sudo java -jar plugin-manager.jar --plugin-download-directory /var/lib/jenkins/plugins --plugins $PLUGINS || true; fi
